deploy.on_merge: Nothing deploys on merge: .github/workflows/verify.yml installs, tests, builds and verifies. A release is `npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=mindicraft`, run by hand from guide/ (build.mjs header; guide/wrangler.toml).
deploy.rules: AGENTS.md: `npm --prefix guide run verify` proves the committed build; the reviewed shelves (remedies, healing arts, cognition, wildfire) keep their pinned bytes and need deliberate re-review to change. Open PRs #4–#8 change the home and the hall, so the look may move before a kit lands.

notes: The site is generated: guide/build.mjs writes every page into guide/dist (gitignored) from template strings, and copies static files by name (cpSync of style.css, learning-system.mjs, xenia-worker.js as _worker.js). So the page heads are read from build.mjs (site.html), and the kit's files would be copied into dist by build.mjs (serve.via): after `npm --prefix guide run build`, run `node guide/brand/check.mjs --served guide/dist`.

build.mjs holds three page heads (the book pages, the root door and one more template). The check reads a site.html file as one page, so once a kit exists it would see three theme-color sets and three color-scheme lines in it and fail even when every head is right. Until it reads each head on its own, the alternative is site.html on the built pages (../dist/**/*.html), which exist only after a build and fail in a fresh clone.

check.mjs is not wired yet; planned: `node brand/check.mjs --served dist` appended after the build inside the `verify` script in guide/package.json (scripts run in guide/), which .github/workflows/verify.yml runs.

Today: the favicon is a 🔥 emoji data URI in build.mjs's templates; /favicon.ico answers 404 (2026-11-05); mindicraft.com answers 200, although ledger kgdm-hub-pr100-ai-invitation (2026-10-20) called the site suspended.
guide/ is the canonical site (AGENTS.md). The root's site/index.html and vercel.json (outputDirectory site) are an older Vercel path; whether anything still deploys it was not checked.
